Markets.title: US stocks: Birkenstock shares jump 15% as strong demand prompts revenue forecast hike
Markets.summary: Birkenstock raised its annual sales growth forecast and saw its shares jump 15% after surpassing quarterly revenue expectations. This strong performance was driven by high demand for its premium sandals, particularly through direct-to-consumer sales and growth in the Asia-Pacific region.

Markets.title: US stocks: Cerebras slumps 12% as mixed quarterly results test AI growth narrative
Markets.summary: Cerebras Systems shares slumped 12% after the company missed financial projections due to declining hardware sales. The results raised concerns about the competitiveness and scaling ability of its artificial intelligence chip sector.

Markets.title: Sebi proposes asset threshold for individuals, corporates to widen accredited investor pool
Markets.summary: Sebi has proposed lowering the asset threshold for individuals to Rs 5 crore and for body corporates to Rs 20 crore to qualify as accredited investors. This change aims to encourage greater participation in alternative investment funds.

Markets.title: US stocks: US market opens higher as investors weigh weaker oil, PPI data
Markets.summary: US stocks opened higher on Thursday morning following a drop in crude oil prices and softer-than-expected producer price inflation data. The Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all recorded gains at the opening bell.

Markets.title: LG Electronics India Q1 Results: PAT rises marginally YoY to Rs 653 crore; revenue up 15%
Markets.summary: LG Electronics India reported a 1.4% year-on-year rise in profit after tax to Rs 653 crore for the first quarter of FY27. During the same quarter, the company's revenue increased by 15%.

Markets.title: IndiQube Spaces Q1 loss narrows to Rs 24 cr
Markets.summary: Realty firm IndiQube Spaces reported a net loss of Rs 23.88 crore for the quarter as total income rose to Rs 448.81 crore. The company currently operates 137 coworking centres across seventeen Indian cities, managing a total area of 10.61 million square feet.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli troops in the West Bank village of Qusra have ordered Palestinian families to leave their homes. The military is using some of these evacuated houses as barracks while Israeli settlers besiege the area.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy the country rather than conquer it now that the war has entered its fifth year.

Geo-Political.title: UK defends seizing shadow fleet tanker after Putin threat
Geo-Political.summary: The UK government defended its seizure of a shadow fleet tanker, stating the action followed the law. This defense came in response to a threat from Russian President Vladimir Putin regarding the disruption of such vessels.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
Geo-Political.summary: The WHO chief states that the current Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, is on track to be the deadliest in history. The epidemic has already caused over 2,000 deaths along with thousands of reported cases.

Geo-Political.title: Four Canadian hockey stars remain suspended after sexual assault acquittal
Geo-Political.summary: Four Canadian hockey players remain suspended despite being acquitted of sexual assault. An appeals board determined that all five players involved violated Hockey Canada's code of conduct, resulting in the reinstatement of only one player.

Geo-Political.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
Geo-Political.summary: Burgas, Bulgaria, will host the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. This decision follows Bulgarian singer Dara's victory in the current year's competition.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a growing shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to help creators improve their digital content production in 2025. These essential technologies are revolutionizing the content creation process and simplifying workflows for creators.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India merchandise exports hit record $44.24 billion for July, trade deficit widens
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise exports reached a record $44.24 billion in July, driving total exports for the April-July period up 17% to $173.78 billion. Despite this growth, the country's trade deficit widened during the same timeframe.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid fluctuating oil prices. This increase matched analyst expectations and could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, while elevated oil prices continue to pose risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong growth outlook and forecasts a 6.4% GDP growth rate. However, the agency also highlighted fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment opportunities.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also notes that India's biggest economic challenge is improving workforce employability rather than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July likely stayed unchanged at 4.4%. This stability occurred despite higher food prices because a favorable base effect and contained underlying inflation offset the upward pressure.

India.title: Man Tied To Pole, Beaten To Death With Sticks Over Theft Suspicion In UP
India.summary: A man named Ram Sneh was beaten to death with sticks in a Uttar Pradesh village after locals caught him on suspicion of theft. The victim, who was a history-sheeter, had been tied to a pole during the incident.

India.title: UP Teen Loses Rs 3 Lakh In Online Games, Uses AI Image To Fake Own Kidnapping
India.summary: An Uttar Pradesh teenager lost three lakh rupees playing online games and used artificial intelligence to fake his own kidnapping for ransom. When his father could not transfer the money online, the teenager demanded two lakh rupees in cash.

India.title: Kerala High Court Restores Foreign Funding Licence Of 2 NGOs, Questions Centre
India.summary: The Kerala High Court restored the foreign funding licences of the Kerala Social Service Forum and Save A Family Plan India. The court also questioned the central government regarding its handling of the cases.

India.title: UGC NET June 2026 Answer Key Live: Direct Link To Download PDF, Response Sheet, Question Paper, Objection Window Details
India.summary: The UGC NET June 2026 provisional answer key, question paper, and response sheet will be made available for download online. Applicants can raise objections against discrepancies found in the answer key through the official objection window.

India.title: Bihar Students To Go On Hunger Strike From August 18, Demand Education Minister's Resignation
India.summary: Students in Bihar plan to begin a hunger strike on August 18 to demand the resignation of their education minister. The protests were triggered by the failure to release the TRE 4 notification in July as previously promised.

India.title: Ugandan Woman Deported From Hyderabad Over Alleged Drug Links
India.summary: A Ugandan woman was deported from Hyderabad for overstaying her visa. Police also cited her suspected involvement in drug networks as a reason for the deportation.

General.title: Water bills set to rise for many after firms permitted extra funding
General.summary: Ofwat has provisionally approved requests from 13 water companies to increase customer bills. The extra funding will be used to pay for new investments in the water system.

General.title: Son pays tribute to dad, 102, who died after allegedly being assaulted in pub
General.summary: Phillip Ormerod, 102, died in the hospital after he was allegedly assaulted inside a pub. Police confirmed his death, prompting his son to pay public tribute to him.

General.title: The key signs you may have damaged your eyes by looking at the eclipse
General.summary: Looking directly at the sun without proper eclipse glasses can damage your eyes. A key symptom of this solar retinopathy is blurred vision.

General.title: Busiest ever period for England's A&Es as extreme heat hits
General.summary: More than 2.4 million visits in each of last three months, as unions warn of inhumane conditions.

General.title: Harvey Nichols bought by owner of Sports Direct
General.summary: The department store made famous by sitcom Absolutely Fabulous had warned it would cease trading.

General.title: Met chief accepts mistakes made over Simon Levy but defends investigation into murders
General.summary: Critics - including Labour MP Jess Phillips - have accused the Met of overlooking the first murder carried out by Levy.
